element.description: The business FUNCTION (or matched capability) an existing service already provides — never a role or a person.

realised_by.description: The as-is service that provides it, named as the AI or traditional as-is architecture names it.

unrealised.description: Business functions nothing in the as-is estate provides today — they must be built.

shortlist.description: The VIABLE candidate realisations per matched technology capability — not every route the view lists — with exactly one PREFERRED per capability. A shortlist, not the selection: that is step 21's.

capability_id.description: The L3 id (e.g. KNW.01), copied from a realisation row you were shown.

preferred.description: True on exactly one entry per capability: the route this step would lead with, and why.

estate_touched.description: The traditional (non-AI) services this use case would touch, by the service name in the traditional as-is architecture — recorded separately from the AI realisations.
